content: {"like": ["Jessica Raine was the only bright spot in the effort."], "dislike": ["The film had an agonizingly slow pace that felt like a slog in slow-motion wooden direction.", "The director seemed to drag the audience along with a pace that felt like watching water boil.", "Situations were filled with dead air where nothing happened, causing confusion.", "The male lead Tommy had only one expression to cover his character, making him appear as a moronic bumbling statue.", "The acting was single-expression and unsatisfactory, leading to confusion and shouting at the screen.", "The film’s decisions were often not appropriate to the situation, leaving the audience confused."]}
